_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native and resident of Kerala State.
   1. The children/dependents of survivors (victims) of crime are eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. The combined annual income of the families should be less than ₹1,00,000/-.
   1. The children pursuing a degree and higher education courses in government and aided institutions and admitted to merit seats in unaided institutions are eligible for financial assistance in courses from the degree level onwards.

**Note:** If granted for one year, the amount can be granted in subsequent years if the head of the school or college or the head of the newly joined institution certifies that the child will continue his education.
